title: Arcane Nullifier
summary: Arcane Nullifier is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to resist a  Magnetic status effect entirely.
extract:
Arcane Nullifier is an Arcane Enhancement that provides a chance to resist a  Magnetic status effect entirely.
Can be sold for  200.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Teralyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Venus Proxima, Neptune Proxima, and Pluto Proxima missions.
May appear as a Tier 1, 3 or 9 reward in The Circuit on a weekly rotational basis.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.

visit here.

History
Arcane Nullifier was first introduced in the Trial mission The Law of Retribution, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Nullifier from Little Duck for 1,000  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Nullifier from Father for 200  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Nullifier from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 3  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Nullifier from Ordis for 1  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 2 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.

Notes
A Rank 5 Arcane Nullifier provides total immunity to  Magnetic proc.
